definitions.explanation: Describes relationships, situations, or resolutions that are smooth, without conflict or friction. Implies completeness and balance, from the kanji {円|えん} (round, complete).

examples.japanese: {円満|えんまん}な{家庭|かてい}を{築|きず}きたい。
examples.english: I want to build a harmonious family.

examples.japanese: {話|はな}し{合|あ}いは{円満|えんまん}に{解決|かいけつ}した。
{二人|ふたり}は{円満|えんまん}{離婚|りこん}したと{報道|ほうどう}されている。
examples.english: It has been reported that the two had an amicable divorce.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a な-adjective. Common in describing family life, workplace relationships, and legal/business resolutions. {円満|えんまん}{退職|たいしょく} (amicable resignation) and {円満|えんまん}{離婚|りこん} (amicable divorce) are set phrases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {円満|えんまん}な{家庭|かてい} (harmonious household)
- {円満|えんまん}{解決|かいけつ} (amicable resolution)
- {円満|えんまん}{退職|たいしょく} (amicable resignation)
- {円満|えんまん}{離婚|りこん} (amicable divorce)
